name: Hartshorn Farm
tagline: Hartshorn Farm: Discover Vermont's Best Organic Farm Tours & Maple Syrup Experiences
description: An independent farm in Lincoln, VT, Hartshorn Farm grows Herbs and Eggs. The farm is busiest through much of the year. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
